dedupe_keys.name: idb summary dataset of water and sanitation tariff structures in latin america 85 country service rows for 12 countries block counts prices fixed fees bills at 1 to 15 m3 2022

description: The IDB Water and Sanitation Division publishes a summary of residential water and wastewater tariff structures compiled from utility tariff schedules for its OLAS observatory. Contents: 85 rows, each a country, a service (water, wastewater, or both) and a general tariff type (fixed fee, volumetric, increasing block and others), with means and standard deviations across the country's utilities for the number of blocks, first block size, kink point, first and final block prices, fixed fee, minimum charge and the bill for 1, 6, 12 and 15 cubic metres. Producer: the IDB knowledge team, from national and utility public sources. Coverage: Bolivia, Brazil, Colombia, Costa Rica, Ecuador, El Salvador, Guatemala, Honduras, Mexico, Panama, Paraguay and Uruguay, reference year 2022. Format and access: a 13 KB CSV on IDB Open Data with a DOI and CKAN datastore API; no registration. Licence: CC BY 4.0. Caveats: the portal description text refers only to Bolivia although the file covers twelve countries; values are country averages, not utility-level tariffs, and currency units are not stated in the fields. Simulation uses: parameterising household demand response and affordability in water system planning models, and cost recovery assumptions in capacity planning. Related records: the IDB OLAS water stress dataset (data-idb-olas-population-water-stress-risk-municipal-lac) comes from the same observatory.
